fromTable.description: True: the sender's own game began on its table (A11). Taken from the starter only.

newMatch.description: True: end the open match and start one with everyone set to Play (the explicit press, never set with `fromTable`).

anyway.description: A13: the sender confirmed a start with a table that cannot report ball ends.

now.description: Do not wait: start without the 3D connections and without the people whose table is not ready (a second press).

description: client -> host, in a lobby. A member asks for a start. The host announces it (HELLO_ACK `start`) or answers REJECT (`unexpected_state`) whose `message` is the sentence the asker is shown.
